posts.name: PlatinumWarlock
posts.cooked:
Just got my copy yesterday, and it'll certainly see some play tonight at our New Years' Eve party!

Overall, I'm pretty pleased.  While I'm not as a big a van of the Vengeance play-style as I am of normal SotM, I think that the additional variety that VotM brings will make Vengeance-style play a lot more appealing.  Greazer's mechanics are pretty interesting, as are Sergeant Steel's, and I rather like how their unique elements trigger.  Further, there are a lot more Ongoing and other similar cards that read "When this card enters play, X happens", somewhat combining the idea of a One-Shot with an Ongoing.  It's a neat idea...

I've got to say, though, that my favorite part of the expansion thusfar might be the Environments.  Vampire castle?  Ancient ninja fortress?  Twisted carnival?  Oh yeah...that's right up my alley!

 

Oh, and there's no preview for the (presumably) final SotM expansion.  No art, no mention, nothing.
